team.abilityDesc: The Pokémon's intense focus prevents it from flinching or being affected by Intimidate.

moves.name: Wing Attack
moves.desc: The target is struck with large, imposing wings spread wide to inflict damage.

moves.name: Bite
moves.desc: The target is bitten with viciously sharp fangs. This may also make the target flinch.

moves.name: Confuse Ray
moves.desc: The target is exposed to a sinister ray that causes confusion.

moves.name: Supersonic
moves.desc: The user generates odd sound waves from its body that confuse the target.

team.abilityDesc: The Pokémon's limber body prevents it from being paralyzed. This also prevents it from being trapped or bound by moves. This also prevents its speed from being lowered.

moves.name: Fake Out
moves.desc: This attack hits first and makes the target flinch. It works only on the first turn each time the user enters battle.

moves.name: Fury Swipes
moves.desc: The user attacks by raking the target with claws, scythes, or the like. This move hits two to five times in a row.

moves.name: Hypnosis
moves.desc: The user employs hypnotic suggestion to make the target fall asleep.

moves.name: Feint Attack
moves.desc: The user approaches the target disarmingly, then throws a sucker punch. This attack never misses.
